statement: The FRED series DGS10 records a daily value at or above 5.00 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 4.78 percent on the packet date, 2026-09-07.
resolution: TRUE if the FRED series DGS10 carries any observation greater than or equal to 5.00 for a date between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-18 inclusive, read at the deadline. FALSE otherwise. Reference level at seal: 4.78 percent.
failure_condition: The maximum DGS10 daily value across 2026-09-14 to 2026-12-18 remains below 5.00 percent.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 110.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-27. Reference: 96.28 on the packet date, 2026-09-07.
resolution: TRUE if ICE publishes a front-month Brent settlement price greater than or equal to 110.00 for any trading day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-27 inclusive. Intraday highs do not count; settlement prices only. Reference level at seal: 96.28.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement inside the window prints below 110.00 dollars.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
